description_en: Retrieves a list of image upgrade tasks
description_zh: 获取镜像升级任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-fota-tasks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --task-uid aot-c4khwrp9ocml40000 --user-status Pending --fota-status windows --lang zh --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFotaTasks

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.
Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100
默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that there are no more results
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The list of image upgrade tasks
parameters.help_zh: 镜像升级任务的信息列表
parameters.name: task_uid

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the image upgrade task is automatically pushed
parameters.help_zh: 设置镜像升级任务是否自动推送
parameters.name: user_status

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: fota_status

parameters.help_en: The language type of the upgrade version description
parameters.help_zh: 升级版本说明的语言类型
parameters.name: lang

Code.description_en: The result of the operation. A value of `success` indicates success. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Code.description_zh: 修改结果。返回`success`表示成功，否则将返回错误信息

AppVersion.description_en: The image version. You can call [DescribeImages]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188895.html） to obtain this parameter
AppVersion.description_zh: 镜像版本。可调用[DescribeImages]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188895.html）获取该参数

FotaProject.description_en: This parameter is not publicly available

PendingCustomImageCount.description_en: The number of custom images that can be upgraded to this version
PendingCustomImageCount.description_zh: 可升级到该版本的自定义镜像数量

PendingDesktopCount.description_en: The number of cloud desktops that can be upgraded to this version
PendingDesktopCount.description_zh: 可升级到该版本的云电脑数量

PublishTime.description_en: The release time of the upgrade version. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
PublishTime.description_zh:
升级版本的发布时间。
时间格式为 ISO 8601 标准的 UTC 时间：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

ReleaseNote.example: 修复已知问题，提升系统稳定性

Size.description_en: The size of the upgrade package, in KB

Status.description_en: Indicates whether the image upgrade task is automatically pushed
Status.description_zh: 镜像升级任务是否自动推送

TaskUid.description_en: The ID of the image upgrade task

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned when Code is `success`
Message.description_zh: 错误信息。当Code为`success`时，不返回该参数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that there are no more results
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
